# RoughHeatKernel

Source API 0.11.0. Public repository interface:
https://github.com/chenle02/rough-heat-kernel-lean

Read the exact Lean statement before using a result. The source declaration
determines every hypothesis and quantifier; each receipt covers only its named
scientific content. A version number alone does not establish verification.

Required context:
- [README and verification authority](https://github.com/chenle02/rough-heat-kernel-lean/blob/main/README.md#verification-at-a-glance)
- [Clone contract](source/AGENTS.md)
- [Mathematical scope](status.html)
- [Exact reusable API](api.html)
- [Trust model](trust.html)
- [Claims](source/claims.yaml)
- [Public theorem inventory](source/THEOREM_INVENTORY.txt)
- [Contribution guidance](source/CONTRIBUTING.md)

Use lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json unchanged in a frozen replay.
Do not infer full-paper SPDE well-posedness or remove theorem hypotheses.

Historical attribution: [Earlier development resources](citation.html#historical-compute). Current release executors and checked scope are recorded by the source-bound receipts.

New deterministic APIs: joint positive-time continuity for positive and signed Gaussian-tempered heat flows; uniform quarter-Holder Gaussian kernel increments with universal constant 2*exp(1). No time-zero continuity, stochastic sample modification or SPDE claim. Current-source full verification and independent three-kernel comparison passed at 133f3aec2c12; prior 0.7 receipts remain historical.

Added in 0.10.0 (verification pending): real Beta integral on [0, t] (DLMF 5.12.1); squared-kernel and semigroup identities for heatKernel (nu * t); erf, erfc, normalDensity, normalCDF with normalCDF 0 = 1/2, derivative, normalCDF x = (1 + erf(x/sqrt 2))/2, and sum_k z^k / Gamma(k/2 + 1) = e^(z^2) (1 + erf z) for z >= 0 (DLMF 7.6.2).

Added in 0.11.0 (verification pending): erf derivative, continuity, parity, signs and limits at plus/minus infinity, erfc derivative and limit; normalDensity nonnegative with total mass 1; normalCDF in [0, 1], monotone, >= 1/2 on [0, infinity); the shifted semigroup identity int p_a(y-m) p_b(x-y) dy = p_(a+b)(x-m) and its integrability (now public); lheatFlow_sq_eq (now public); the pointwise-in-time Chen-Dalang step lintegral_sq_lheatFlow_mul_le; ofReal(int f) <= int^- ofReal f for nonnegative f without integrability.
